patterns.name: Repeated Login Failure Burst
patterns.basis: Emotet, OilRig and Dragonfly guessed passwords against few accounts with many rapid failed logins (T1110.001).

patterns.name: Shared Password Across Many Accounts
patterns.basis: APT28, APT29 (2023-24 Microsoft mail intrusion) and APT33 sprayed one common password across many accounts (T1110.003).

patterns.name: Leaked Credential Pairs Across Many Accounts
patterns.basis: Chimera and the 2023 23andMe incident replayed leaked username/password pairs, one attempt per account (T1110.004).
